LOADING PACKAGES

source("../load_packages.R")

LOADING FILES

source("../load_files.R")

SRRs <- SRRs %>%
  separate(Library.Name, into = c("State", "time", "rep"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(State = ifelse(
    grepl("^PB", State),
    "infected",
    "control"
  )) %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(time, "_", State, "_", rep), 
        time = as.numeric(time)) %>%
  arrange(time)

# Create count matrixes for all genes + bacterial genes+ phage genes
source("../count_matrices.R")

# Quality control steps
source("../qc_steps.R")

CLR

source("../CLR.R")
source("../CLR_control.R")
wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)

# Construction of a distance matrix for PCoA
dist_matrix_cts <- cts[c("Run", "Geneid", 'counts')] %>%
  group_by(Run, Geneid) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Run,
    values_from = counts, 
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(dist_matrix_cts) <- dist_matrix_cts$Geneid
dist_matrix_cts <- dist_matrix_cts[ , -1]

dist_matrix_cts <- vegdist(t(dist_matrix_cts), method = "euclidean")

# Compute principal coordinate decomposition
pcoa <- pcoa(dist_matrix_cts)

# Plot PCoA2 vs PCoA2
pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  Run = rownames(pcoa$vectors),
  Axis1 = pcoa$vectors[, 1],
  Axis2 = pcoa$vectors[, 2]
)
pcoa_df <- left_join(pcoa_df, SRRs, by = "Run")
pcoa_df <- pcoa_df %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(ifelse(State == "infected", "I", "C"), " ", time)
  )

ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = State, label = label)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.8, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("infected" = "red",  
               "control" = "darkblue")   
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA 1 (", round(pcoa$values$Relative_eig[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA 2 (", round(pcoa$values$Relative_eig[2] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    color = "Condition")

COMPUTE CORRELATION BETWEEN DEFENSE SYSTEMS EXPRESSION AND BACTERIAL GROWTH / PHAGE GROWTH

source("../correlation_ds_growth.R")
conditions <- c("infected", "control")

for (condition in conditions) {
  for (ds_ in unique(ds$type)) {
    save_correlation(ds_, median_growth_markers_clr, "ribosome", condition)
    # no structural phage gene reported by genomad
    #save_correlation(ds_, median_struct_phage_clr, "phage", condition)
  }
}
